decisions.base: 285 original player cards from BCP + independent MCB, 200 regular and 85 SP: 20 All-Stars, 30 Team Players, 35 Prospects; same collector checklist. True RCs only Spurling 254, Maldonado 262 and Nussbeck 275 per TCDB.
decisions.sourceDiscrepancies: Base #178 Bob/Bobby Abreu, #242 Bob/Bobby Higginson; numbered HM #25 Bob/Bobby Abreu; Fall Classic #8 Jimmy/Jimmie Foxx and #10 Roger/Rogers Hornsby, reviewed independently.
decisions.gaps: Though marketed as a 39-number Fall Classic insert, #11FC,17FC,30FC never issued: 36 physical collectibles; BCP and MCB agree exact 36.
decisions.gold: Entire original 285 has Gold Medallion, not Platinum Medallion. 1-200 once per pack; 201-250 1:24; 251-285 serialized /100. VCS G is parallel registry notation; not invented printed number.
decisions.parallelMemo: No 2002 base Platinum Medallion. Actual Platinum /25 memorabilia variations modeled for Hitting Machines Bats 23, On the Road Jerseys 14, Glove Works Gloves 9, Rising Stars Hats 6.
decisions.memo: Preserve real subjects/materials/print quantities and Glove Works first-75 batting-glove patch variations. Separate unnumbered memorabilia as distinct virtual identifiers.
decisions.channel: Hitting Machines base inserts retail only; Fall Classic numbered inserts hobby only. No mixing hobby/retail odds.
decisions.odds: 10-card hobby packs x 24; product set odds NULL pending proper Gold slot, subsets, serial and retail/hobby eligibility, no made-up pull rates.
decisions.release: Create only new unreleased 2002 Ultra product; prices, source scans and original pack/box images pending QA. No change to existing ProductSets.

productSets.name: Base Set
productSets.notes: 285 collector-numbered base, 1-200 regular, 201-220 All-Stars, 221-250 Team Players, 251-285 Prospects. All three SPs 1:4 hobby and 1:10 retail, each remains in single base checklist.

productSets.name: Gold Medallion
productSets.notes: 285 genuine Gold counterparts. Normal #1-200 one per pack, All-Stars/Team Players 1:24, Prospects #251-285 /100. Original physical number same as base; G suffix is VCS registry identifier.

productSets.name: Printed Checklists (NNO)
productSets.notes: One authentic unnumbered original checklist #1-220, independent MCB and TCDB. Separate from 285 player base.

productSets.name: Rising Stars
productSets.notes: 15 verified 1 RS to 15 RS numbered insert cards, hobby 1:12 retail 1:20.

productSets.name: Glove Works
productSets.notes: 15 verified 1 GW to 15 GW numbered insert cards, hobby 1:20 retail 1:36.

productSets.name: Hitting Machines (Retail)
productSets.notes: 25 verified numbered 1 HM-25 HM retail-only inserts, 1:20 retail; never in original hobby wax.

productSets.name: Fall Classic (Hobby)
productSets.notes: 36 actually issued FC-numbered cards, hobby-only 1:20. The nominal 39-numbered checklist has nonexistent #11FC,#17FC,#30FC, excluded.
